title: MiG-29K / KUB (carrier)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The MiG-29K is the carrier version of the newer MiG-29M family (the KUB is the two-seater): it has folding wings, a tail hook, a strengthened landing gear, digital fly-by-wire (computers between the stick and the control surfaces) and a glass cockpit. JoyPro takes its stick, throttles and panels from the MiG-29SMT and the 9.12, so this guide follows the SMT guide. The hook and wing fold controls are not listed as separate items in the catalog.
